name: ACE OF SPADES 2
source:
There is a special casino that only accepts customers who bring women partners along. The bet there is not money, but women as the losing side has to pass woman to the winner.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-june-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一家特殊的赌场，只接待携女伴一同前来的客人。这里的赌注不是金钱，而是女人：输家必须把自己的女伴交给赢家。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-june-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
